root_idea.summary: An orientation toward unauthorized flight or withdrawal, associated in the root tradition with constraint and strictness in dealing.
root_idea.development: The lexical field extends from fleeing to hiding, holding oneself back, and abstaining. Derived Form V develops specialized uses for withholding milk and denying or disavowing, while a distinct noun denotes hemp.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The canonical Quran-attested Form I verb is presented under its normalized Classical Arabic citation form.

senses.definition: To flee or run away, especially in an unauthorized departure.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence describes Jonah fleeing toward the laden ship after departing from his people. The same flight sense is classically used for a slave leaving a master without permission and may be extended figuratively to a fish.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hide or conceal oneself, sometimes hiding before subsequently going away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical discussion also gives poetic applications involving not hiding or not going far.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To restrain, confine, or withhold oneself; to refrain from something, including a sin or crime.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Poetic applications include holding back speech or oneself; variant interpretations include not refraining and not disdaining or scorning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hide oneself by imitating a runaway.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V intransitive use describing a person's concealment.
A Form V use attested of a camel withholding her milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deny or disavow something; to refuse to acknowledge an attributed quality or a kinship relation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V construction may take either an asserted quality or a relationship as the matter being denied.
آبِقٌ is the active participle of أَبَقَ. أَبَّاقٌ can carry an intensive or frequentative sense, referring to one who runs away often.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hemp, or the bast-fiber plant whose stems are beaten to release the fiber.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a distinct nominal use, reported as an identification of the plant mentioned in poetic evidence.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Flight, concealment, and self-restraint or abstention branches are represented; the fish usage is subsumed under the flight sense.
